verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of CIBA (Client Initiated Backchannel Authentication) or any asynchronous out-of-band approval flow; the closest related item is the device authorization grant (kc-supp-device-grant), which is a different flow (polling for a user to authenticate on a separate device, not backchannel push-approval of an in-flight agent transaction). Since the axis clearly applies to an OIDC/OAuth identity provider like Keycloak but no supporting evidence is present, this must be judged 'none'. Missing for 10: any documentation or reference to CIBA support, backchannel authentication endpoint, or async approval workflow for autonomous agent transactions.
